title: File:Ford Model 91A at Torkham - Annemarie Schwarzenbach.jpg
desc: British India, Torkham (Turkham, Tor Khum, Towr Kham): The Ford next to a plaque inscribed "Frontier of India" and a stone inscribed "Limit of British India".

title: File:Torkham border crossing in September 2011-cropped.jpg
art: Master Sgt. Michael O'Connor (US armed forces), cropped by Officer
desc: Marine Corps Gen. John R. Allen, commander of NATO and International Security Assistance Force troops in Afghanistan, visited military and civilian personnel assigned to Regional Command-East, Nangarhar province, Sept. 5.   Allen received a briefing and walking tour of Torkham Gate area of operation

title: File:Inside the Afghan customs and border patrol station at Torkham-2.jpg
desc: Afghan customs officials check travelers' passports at Torkham Gate in Nangarhar province, Afghanistan, April 24, 2013. The customs and border patrol station on the Afghan side of the Khyber Pass regulates traffic flow between Pakistan and Afghanistan. (Photo ID: 915738)
